market_name: Will 12 or more Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market probability move is a real shift or thin-liquidity noise; cross-check Fed funds futures (SOFR/ZQ) and 2y/10y yields for confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Look for any macro catalyst (jobs data, bank stress, geopolitical shock) that would justify a 300bps-cut expectation; confirm TLT is bid alongside falling yields.
time_plan.2h: Re-assess whether bond rally is broadening or fading; watch VIX and credit spreads (HYG) for corroborating recession/risk signal.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate persistence of the rate-cut repricing and whether equity/FX markets echo the dovish shift; update if move has reversed.
time_plan.12h: Final check: did TLT hold gains and did rate-cut pricing sustain? Log whether the prediction-market move led or lagged public rate markets.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 12+ (i.e. 300bps of) Fed cuts in 2026 would signal expectations of aggressive easing, typically tied to a recession or financial-crisis scenario. That regime drives front-end and long-end yields lower, pushing long-duration Treasury prices (TLT) up. The proxy is directly exposed to the rate-expectations channel, but a 12h window rarely produces the magnitude such a tail scenario implies unless a genuine macro shock is unfolding.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify the move is genuine and check DXY and 2y yield reaction; distinguish dovish-Fed weakness from crisis safe-haven flows.
time_plan.1h: Watch EURUSD and USDJPY for confirmation of dollar direction; check for risk-off signals that could flip USD stronger.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether easing narrative or haven narrative dominates FX; adjust view accordingly.
time_plan.6h: Re-check dollar trend and whether rate-differential story is holding.
time_plan.12h: Final review: did UUP weaken consistent with dovish repricing, or did haven demand reverse it? Log outcome.

predictions.reasoning: Expectations of 300bps of Fed cuts imply a collapsing US rate differential versus other economies, which is dollar-negative. A spike in this market's yes-probability would therefore point to USD weakness via UUP. However, in an actual crisis the dollar often catches a safe-haven bid, muddying the direction — hence low confidence.

evidence_used: Market question implies 12+ cuts = ~300bps easing in 2026, an extreme dovish/recession-scale scenario
Standard macro linkages: aggressive Fed easing expectations lower yields (bond prices up) and typically weaken USD
Fed funds futures and Treasury yields are the direct transmission channel for rate-cut probability shifts
uncertainty_notes: A 12h window is very unlikely to produce moves near the 700bps tradable threshold, so neither prediction is tradable
Direction depends heavily on whether the driver is a benign dovish shift or a genuine crisis — crisis flows can send USD up and equities down while bonds still rally
Prediction-market probability moves in illiquid tail contracts are often noise, not information leakage
Topic tagged 'military_conflict' is likely a mislabel; this is a pure macro/monetary market

llm_justification.summary: This market prices an extreme tail (300bps of Fed cuts in 2026). A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive easing, most plausibly tied to recession or crisis. The cleanest public-market implications are long-duration Treasuries higher (TLT) and the dollar lower (UUP) via the rate-expectations channel. Both mappings are directionally reasonable but low-confidence and well below the 700bps tradable bar over 12h; crisis-driven safe-haven flows could invert the USD call and complicate equities.
key_assumptions: A rise in yes-probability reflects genuine dovish/recession expectations rather than thin-market noise
The prediction-market move leads or coincides with, rather than lags, public rate-market repricing
Standard rate-differential and duration relationships hold within the window
failure_modes: Move was already public/priced in via Fed funds futures, so no incremental asset move
In an actual crisis the dollar rallies on safe-haven demand, reversing the UUP call
The prediction-market shift is illiquid noise with no macro catalyst
Expected 12h magnitude is far below the 700bps threshold, so signal is non-tradable even if directionally correct
Equity direction is ambiguous (easing bullish vs recession bearish), so no equity proxy was chosen
